skill-redesign.description: Reexamine and possibly unify the Claude Code skills (stackr, sr-sandbox, sr-implement) from first principles

context.text: Unified the 3 Claude skills (stackr/sr-sandbox/sr-implement) into ONE skill at .claude/skills/stackr/ with progressive disclosure: SKILL.md + sandbox.md + implement.md
Cross-skill refs aren't load-bearing (skills load independently); same-dir progressive disclosure IS reliable. One description routes all 3 intents. Kills 3-way drift + mechanism split.
Stayed with skill over MCP per ADR-0003 (MCP built+removed; CLI already emits JSON via --aiprepare; ~50 tools = permanent context tax)
Defer command flags to 'sr --help' (drift-proof); keep only compact command MAP inline so agents can discover commands they'd otherwise never --help
Consider an ADR for the unified-skill + go:embed-dir + drift-test pattern if it proves durable
